page.overview:
Who is Estan?

When speaks to , she greets him and asks what he eats for breakfast, lunch, or dinner depending on the time of day. If says that he eats meat, comments that he has good taste. If Link says that he eats vegetables, she insists that he must have meant meat. wonders if , the woman who stands near her , has something against meat, but she mutters that this is impossible. After has been calmed, is very grateful and thanks .

When buys 's meats, she calls it a good purchase. If has bought all of her stock, she thanks him for doing so. Not only does sell her wares, she will also buy from . When she accidentally says "sarqso" instead of thank you, she appears disappointed. She is grateful for 's patronage.
